answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is forfeited if it breaks protocol, and cap its influence by the bond rather than by its claimed identity count. A Sybil attacker can still create thousands of accounts, but splitting capital among them does not multiply voting weight; gaining influence means locking up more real funds and risking loss. The kernel can set the cap, while a zenith of proven reliability may earn gradual increases; a violet badge alone grants nothing. This makes identities cheap but effective influence costly.
